newsitem.title: USA: Amway Japan cost of goods to rise.
newsitem.headline: Amway Japan cost of goods to rise.

text.p: Amway Japan Ltd said Friday that effective June 1, 1997, prices for products purchased from Amway Corp will increase on average by about 7.5 percent.
Amway Japan said that about 62 percent of its cost of sales for fiscal 1996 represented purchases of products from Amway Corp.
The company said it does not anticipate broad based changes in distributor pricing for existing products as a result of this increase.

The company said it calculates the new implicit exchange rate to be about 115 yen per dollar, which is higher than the 107 yen used for purchases during the first three quarters of fiscal 1997, but below the current 125 yen market rate.
Amway Japan's third quarter ends May 31, 1997.
